newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian electricity consumption slips in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Italian electricity consumption slips in Sept.

text.p: Electricity consumption in Italy slipped 0.9 percent year-on-year in September, utility company Enel said on Wednesday.
"The decline in demand was in line with the weak (demand) seen from the start of the year," Enel said in a statement.
In the first nine months of 1996, electricity consumption rose just 0.3 percent compared with the same period last year.
Enel said that the service sector was largely to thank for maintaining electricity demand, while demand in the industrial sector was still in decline.
In total, Italy used up 21.4 billion kWh of electricity in September. Italian producers supplied some 18.3 billion kWh of this demand, down 0.3 percent on September 1995 levels.
